description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) HAIL OF VENGEANCE (Devastator Brethren, 2 CP) — WP-M3b (SMCodexB.gd, through the custom:sm11e dispatcher). Fixture sm11e_m3b_reactive (P1 Orks ACTIVE vs P2 Space Marines, round 2; layout in tests/helpers/gen_sm11e_m3b_fixtures.gd). Setup privileges plus: the Flash Gitz 3" forward; one Hellblaster on 1 wound left and the others sturdy (so the volley destroys a model but not the unit). The Ork player's Flash Gitz shoot the Hellblasters; enemy_has_shot opens for the Space Marines player with ctx.destroyed_unit_ids naming the Hellblasters (new ShootingPhase post-shot ctx key); a real click spends 2 CP; the Hellblasters shoot back (normal shooting, auto-resolved, can only target the Flash Gitz — the engine's forced-target 'shoot' follow-up).

steps.comment: setup privilege: the Space Marines player gets the eight WP-M2b detachments (stratagems reloaded), auto wound allocation, the other player 0 CP (no stratagem windows not under test)
steps.equals: Terminator Storm Force + Assault Brethren + Gravis Linebreaker Force + Devastator Brethren + Gravis Siege Force + Tactical Brethren + Ironclad Champions + Tacticus Firestorm Force

steps.comment: setup privilege: straight to the phase under test
a window not under test (if any) is declined
the Ork player's Flash Gitz shoot the Hellblasters (the shooting panel's SHOOT)
the defender's reactive dialog (TDF / ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT, not under test) comes first
REAL click: decline the reactive stratagems (not under test)
the Ork player's own post-shot windows (none at 0 CP) come first
a Hellblaster was destroyed (setup: one model on 1 wound left), the unit survives
ctx.destroyed_unit_ids: those attacks destroyed a model in the Hellblasters
Flash Gitz wounds before the reply (logged)
REAL click (the Space Marines player) on the stratagem's Use button
